reviews.text: This tale gives us the comfort of characters we know and love with a brand new style and rhythm.
reviews.author: Yasmine Kandil

reviews.text: Indubitably, with Enola Holmes, the game is indeed afoot for a quality adventure and decent mystery; but mostly, the audience will be enchanted by the young detective and her humor and humanity.
reviews.author: Nadine Whitney

reviews.text: Millie Bobbie Brown stars as the title character in Enola Holmes. Brown, known as Eleven on Stranger Things, is radiant in this mature role where she is obviously having the time of her life.
reviews.author: Jillian Chilingerian

reviews.text: Enola Holmes offers a pleasant, refreshing take on a franchise that might have a new future now. Millie Bobby Brown keeps climbing up the stairs of success, demonstrating her versatility, range, and maturity as a young actress.
reviews.author: Manuel São Bento

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a fun, charming, action-adventure flick. Millie Bobby Brown is a star that will inspire viewers to either check out her filmography or convince them to read the books the movie is based on.
reviews.author: Kate Boyle

reviews.text: It’s a fun, vibrant, personality-rich adventure soaked in themes of womanhood, self-discovery, and finding your way in the world.
reviews.author: Keith Garlington

reviews.text: Enola Holmes was an unexpected but welcomed treat. The film offers adventure, comedy, mystery, and personal growth. In a world of cinema where female-led properties are lacking, Enola Holmes is ready to fill that void.
reviews.author: David Gonzalez

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a ride that pays off, giving me a feminist storyline with purpose, a young heroine who saves the day and the men who doubt her, and even glimpses of a budding romance rooted in mutual respect and shared goals.
reviews.author: Kay-B

reviews.text: Along with offering a fresh spin on the literary mythology of the Holmes siblings, Enola Holmes makes a strong case for Millie Bobby Brown as the face of a new franchise set within that world.
reviews.author: Rick Marshall

reviews.text: This movie is an enjoyable romp, dominated by the sparkling personality of Enola (Brown). Director Harry Bradbeer uses playful graphics and other inventive storytelling techniques which add much to the light, enjoyable tone of this film.
reviews.author: Robert Roten

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a bright, family-friendly watch with a likeable lead that unfortunately ends up feeling a little flimsy.
reviews.author: Laura Potier

reviews.text: If you're looking for a spirited, intelligent role model for kids, you couldn't do much better than Enola Holmes.
reviews.author: Witney Seibold

reviews.text: A witty lead, exciting mysteries, and Edwardian England; who could resist Enola Holmes? Certainly not me.
reviews.author: Therese Lacson

reviews.text: While it loses a little steam as it goes, Enola Holmes is a lovely, well-made and family-friendly slice of entertainment that benefits from a fun performance by Brown.
reviews.author: Mark Meszoros

reviews.text: I found Enola Holmes to be a step in the right direction for an entertaining, and even enlightening take on a promising franchise.
reviews.author: Eric Marchen

reviews.text: While the mystery might be elementary (my dear, notably absent, Watson), the storytelling is winkingly subversive, proclaiming that a new and welcome game is afoot.
reviews.author: Maureen Lee Lenker

reviews.text: It's stylish, playful, epic, and incredibly fun.
reviews.author: Rendy Jones

reviews.text: For anyone looking for a fun, mindless mystery carried by a character they wouldn't mind seeing again, the story of the much cooler Holmes sibling is absolutely the way to go.
reviews.author: Alexis Nedd

reviews.text: With plenty of conspiracies and clue-solving in a brisk and engaging story, all cut to Daniel Pemberton's rousing score, it's a hugely entertaining romp that will bring out the sleuth in you.
reviews.author: James Mottram

reviews.text: From Nancy Drew to Harriet The Spy to Veronica Mars, there is a wonderful tradition of young female detectives that Netflix's new film builds on, and it's great to see it carry on.
reviews.author: Eric Eisenberg

reviews.text: Perhaps one too many breaks of the fourth wall but on the whole, Enola is a delightful little movie that has the potential to be a franchise launching point.
reviews.author: Brian Gill

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a lark of a film that might have the possibility of becoming a mini-franchise for Netflix. Brown is the clear winner of the film, as she embodies everything the character needs to be.
reviews.author: Alex Bentley

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a very worthy addition to the Sherlock Holmes canon.
reviews.author: Nicole Ackman

reviews.text: Most importantly for this moment in our lives, Enola Holmes is just a pleasant time.
reviews.author: Fletcher Powell

reviews.text: Enola Holmes vibrantly does justice to the mystery book series for which it is named, thanks to a splendid cast and a twist-filled, engaging adventure that will leave viewers wanting more Enola Holmes movies.
reviews.author: Carla Hay

reviews.text: Leans hard into the idea that the turn of the century will usher in an era of reform. This is, of course, at odds with reality as well as the fin de siècle thinking of the time.
reviews.author: Pete Vonder Haar

reviews.text: Sam Claflin and Henry Cavill make great turns as Mycroft and Sherlock respectively, but the film's success lies entirely with [Millie Bobbie] Brown...
reviews.author: Jennifer Heaton

reviews.text: All florid, wild nonsense that feels like it's being played at 75% speed.
reviews.author: Tim Brayton

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown is a star and Enola Holmes really highlights her talent. Can we get a trilogy of these movies, please?
reviews.author: Kent Garrison

reviews.text: It's clear that both character and actress are having an equally good time.
reviews.author: Michael Wood

reviews.text: Buoyant and precocious without being even slightly annoying, Brown has pinpoint comic timing, infectious perk, and a wholesome, tomboyish aura: imagine a young Keira Knightley crossed with Phoebe Waller-Bridge.
reviews.author: Robbie Collin

reviews.text: Enola Holmes tries to do a lot, with a story that has no need for political subplots that would completely go over the head of its Young Adult audience.
reviews.author: Shah Shahid

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown's performance is magnetic and the female empowerment message is always welcomed. A fun entertaining 2 hours of escapism.
reviews.author: Rosa Parra

reviews.text: Fleet and mostly exhilarating...an engaging riff on the Holmes mystique, and the start of what could become an enjoyable franchise.
reviews.author: Frank Swietek

reviews.text: It gives us a new unauthorized Holmes sleuth to ponder.
reviews.author: Dennis Schwartz

reviews.text: A welcome and refreshing take on the Sherlock Holmes story, Helena Bonham Carter is a true highlight.
reviews.author: Lauren Veneziani

reviews.text: "Enola Homes" is the kind of movie that the preteen set will surely delight in and watch over and over. I know I would have.
reviews.author: Lindsey Bahr

reviews.text: So delightfully subversive that it deserves to become a Netflix series.
reviews.author: Susan Granger

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown absolutely rules in this movie.
reviews.author: Bob Grimm

reviews.text: I was surprised at how deftly Enola unfolds the mystery, but it is also about women's suffrage and feminism in late 19th-century England. It shows that there are alternative ways to resolve conflict and redress wrongs other than violence.
reviews.author: Sr. Rose Pacatte

reviews.text: Any fan of Sherlock Holmes and detective mysteries will get a kick of out Enola Holmes and Brown's performance.
reviews.author: Ricky Church

reviews.text: ... extremely entertaining, regardless the messy way it was assembled.
reviews.author: Filipe Freitas

reviews.text: The movie is light and energetic and probably won't solve any of the world's problems. But that's fine. There are good and smart and educated people trying to solve a number of the world's problems.
reviews.author: Robert Slack

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown shines in a fun adventure film. [Full Review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Mikel Zorrilla

reviews.text: ... while I wouldn't say this is an award-caliber film, it moves along at a rapidly pleasing pace and is sure to bring more notice of Ms. Brown's many gifts.
reviews.author: Diane Pershing

reviews.text: With luck, future installments will have the courage to get weird. If they're also anchored by the star power of Millie Bobby Brown, we'll really have something to look forward to.
reviews.author: Tim Brennan

reviews.text: [Millie Bobby Brown] has been transfixing audiences for three seasons on Netflix's sci-fi smash "Stranger Things," but even to fans of the series, her performance here is a revelation.
reviews.author: Adam Graham

reviews.text: I'd like to see a follow-up - only this time, get a real mystery writer involved at the screenplay stage.
reviews.author: James Berardinelli

reviews.text: At a little more than two hours, "Enola Holmes" may be a tad long, but there are a lot of threads to unravel and it does so more than satisfactorily.
reviews.author: Kevin Crust

reviews.text: A handsomely shot, well-appointed film that, while lacking nuance, is still one of the most imaginative and stylish incarnations of the Holmes legend we've seen in some time.
reviews.author: Mike Scott

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is that rare gift that falls under the umbrella of 'family film' that still packs a great satisfying wallop for adult audiences too.
reviews.author: Alexandra Heller-Nicholas

reviews.text: Happily, it all works, making the film a jaunty, mildly irreverent sidebar to the Sherlock Holmes canon, and Brown's Enola a bright on-screen role model.
reviews.author: Jason Best

reviews.text: A dull and graceless coming-of-age fable about a female Sherlock Holmes trying by all available means to break free from the traditional trappings of femininity. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Yasser Medina

reviews.text: Brown narrates Enola's adventure with delightful asides to the camera and carries the film beautifully. Spryly made by Harry Bradbeer...
reviews.author: Steve Murray

reviews.text: Along with finding it genuinely entertaining, I believe parents of older children can use it as a launching point to start meaningful discussions, even if they're not the discussions the filmmakers intended.
reviews.author: Megan Basham

reviews.text: ...so gloriously weak that even an Enid Blyton-reading 10-year-old could solve it...
reviews.author: Ruhaan Shah

reviews.text: Gorgeously shot, and it looks amazing, but it's really boring...too bad this movie doesn't work or entertain, because it has all the cinematic goods...extremely dull...
reviews.author: Shawn Edwards

reviews.text: Fleabag director, Harry Bradbeer has crafted a charming adventure.
reviews.author: Joseph Walsh

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is an above-average romp that works best when it concentrates on the details.
reviews.author: Steven Prokopy

reviews.text: Throughout, Brown makes you wonder why you didn't see more female heroes onscreen as a kid, and inspires a new generation with her resilience and fourth wall-breaking humour.
reviews.author: Harry Guerin

reviews.text: Watching the film, one tends to forget that Millie Bobby Brown is only 16. She's the Hollywood star to watch-out-for in the future. Her effortless acting makes you forget Sherlock.
reviews.author: Devesh Sharma

reviews.text: An enjoyable movie with a spunky, spirited heroine. The female-empowerment message is potent but not preachy. Millie Bobby Brown is fun to watch as Enola, and effortlessly runs circles around the two, older male actors who play her brothers.
reviews.author: Ruth Maramis

reviews.text: With a shotgun-blast ending giving way to the remaining secrets, an exciting, yet unknown destiny is laid out for Enola, and it's one which fans would surely want to see.
reviews.author: Andrew Dex

reviews.text: Enola Holmes has all the making of a successful franchise. [Full Review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Diego Batlle

reviews.text: Although at times it feels like its themes feel shallow, Enola Holmes remains entertaining. [Full Review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Susana Guzman De la O

reviews.text: If Brown was a highlight of "Stranger Things," she's a breakout here, clearly carrying the picture and having a blast as a cunning, fearless and inventive young woman coming into her own.
reviews.author: Josh Davis

reviews.text: A subtle stench of the 'not like other girls' trope tarnishes Enola Holmes' otherwise noteworthy treatment of gender.
reviews.author: Alicja Johnson

reviews.text: The real strength of this movie is its characters. Watching Enola work through disguises and deductions is a pure joy, and seeing Sherlock trying to catch up to her and solve the same mystery is a refreshing change of pace.
reviews.author: Courtney Lanning

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is the joy we needed from 2020.
reviews.author: Katey Stoetzel

reviews.text: If about five or 10 minutes could've been left on the floor, Enola Holmes remains enchanting, in large part because Brown is having such a good time hitting different notes.
reviews.author: Andy Crump

reviews.text: Snappy and sometimes downright goofy, this comical adventure is fast and entertaining, loaded with messages about empowerment.
reviews.author: Rich Cline

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown is so great -- balancing her conspiratorial chats to camera with her spirited on-screen antics with flamboyant flair -- I loved it all.
reviews.author: Kate Rodger

reviews.text: [T]he film underestimates the savviness of what should be its natural audience by having her do more running around and martial arts than actual sleuthing.
reviews.author: Alistair Harkness

reviews.text: Really cute and fun to watch.
reviews.author: Asia Frey

reviews.text: In the end, minus the himbo Sherlock and the whiff on intersectional feminism, Brown forcefully rolls Enola Holmes just over the hump of mediocrity.
reviews.author: Ryan Syrek

reviews.text: Delightfully entertaining, 'Enola Holmes' should be the beginning of a fun film franchise. Something good is afoot!
reviews.author: Betty Jo Tucker

reviews.text: The plot may be a little sticky in places, but the occasional hiccups don't hang around, and as the opening salvo in a potential franchise it'll do just nicely.
reviews.author: Terry Staunton

reviews.text: Smart movie when it comes to combining the adventures of Enola with the idea of advocating for women's rights. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Jose Maria Areste

reviews.text: [Millie Bobby Brown] is a delight. She gets to be joyful and she is just radiant, effervescent, and has incredible comic timing.
reviews.author: Christy Lemire

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown is so perfectly cast here.
reviews.author: Lael Loewenstein

reviews.text: Our heroine is one for the ages, with modern values that resonate with this generation.
reviews.author: Jeanmarie Tan

reviews.text: An ideal work for its target audience, with its positive and affirmational message and the considerable charm of its star.
reviews.author: Robert Levin

reviews.text: With her natural English accent, extra long brown hair, and convincing ability to go between adventure and drama, Brown makes for an outstanding and believable young heroine.
reviews.author: Dan Buffa

reviews.text: Starting a promising franchise on the right foot, Enola Holmes eschews its YA formula by implementing its own distinct charm.
reviews.author: Matt Conway

reviews.text: ...a smart but messy piece of popular cinema that twists the cliches it hits just enough to skirt by.
reviews.author: Matthew Dougherty

reviews.text: Spend two hours with a fun, confident young hero who refuses to be confined by either the Victorian age or the movie that exists around her.
reviews.author: Norman Wilner

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is just plain fun, a charming and engaging adventure story anchored by a phenomenal performance from a rising star. It's a movie that the whole family can not only watch together, but genuinely enjoy together - a true rarity.
reviews.author: Allen Adams

reviews.text: The film offers, despite its long duration, forgettable entertainment. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Ruben Peralta Rigaud

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown proves she's more than just a number in this rollicking and thoroughly entertaining romp.
reviews.author: James Croot

reviews.text: While it is a little too bloated and disorganized for its own good, most of the pieces for a good movie are there.
reviews.author: Peter Sobczynski

reviews.text: [Director Harry Bradbeer] has managed to bring Jack Thorne's script to the screen perfectly. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Pablo O. Scholz

reviews.text: The Arthur Conan Doyle estate needn't fret over unauthorized cribbing. All that's really left of Holmes here is the name.
reviews.author: Jesse Hassenger

reviews.text: The story is told with a wink and a nod and never really amounts to much, but Brown carries the day in "Enola Holmes," the probable first installment of a wannabe franchise.
reviews.author: Russ Simmons

reviews.text: When Enola is unraveling mysteries ... it's a breezy and right-minded ramble.
reviews.author: Sean Collier

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a pretty looking endeavour that takes full advantage of Millie Bobby Brown's natural charm on screen to sustain a rather standard aventure flick, with its aim clearly targeted at pleasing younger demographics.
reviews.author: Alejandro Turdó

reviews.text: A strong family movie full of adventure and wit.
reviews.author: Paul McGuire Grimes

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is an engaging, exciting mystery that the entire family will enjoy.
reviews.author: Bobby LePire

reviews.text: The characters, humour, and the hugely enjoyable take on a familiar mythos make Enola Holmes a genuine delight.
reviews.author: Grant Watson

reviews.text: The central mystery gets lost amid too many narrative tangents which divert from the story and prove frustrating. Still, I'd love to see Brown and Cavill continue in their roles, albeit with a more satisfying mystery.
reviews.author: Charles Koplinski

reviews.text: Just the burst of color and energy the Sherlock Holmes film universe needed. A delightful adventure with an infectious charm, energy and rip-roaring pace.
reviews.author: Perri Nemiroff

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a charming action-mystery film with enough twists, turns, and heart to satisfy almost anyone.
reviews.author: Lauren Coates

reviews.text: An Arthur Conan Doyle plot has been tweaked to give it a pop-cultural kick in the posterior and to ensure that Enola has something to do throughout the movie.
reviews.author: Robert Denerstein

reviews.text: Despite a charming cast, this playful young adult take on Sherlock Holmes is elementary stuff.
reviews.author: Charlotte Harrison

reviews.text: At a moment when there's a dearth of new entertainment that provides the escapism we desperately crave, Enola Holmes successfully scratches that itch.
reviews.author: Abby Olcese

reviews.text: Various mysteries, cryptographies and perils pile up and intersect nicely in Jack Thorne's adaptation.
reviews.author: Chris Knight

reviews.text: No one's going to forget Sherlock Holmes.... Hanging out with Enola doesn't seem all that bad; if nothing else, it's a nice change.
reviews.author: Joshua Rivera

reviews.text: It's smart enough to be very much its own thing, and that thing very much belongs to its young star, Millie Bobby Brown.
reviews.author: Bilge Ebiri

reviews.text: The film plays with form the way Enola plays with words: dazzlingly, whimsically and sarcastically. It's a light escape from a world that seems to be getting darker by the day.
reviews.author: Asher Luberto

reviews.text: You certainly won't need a detective to find the fun in watching this highly entertaining film. (Full Content Review for Parents - Violence, etc. - also Available)
reviews.author: Jim Judy

reviews.text: As smart as Enola is, what's more impressive is how Brown has been able to pull off such a film. Not only has she found the perfect vehicle to advance her clever and progressive image, but she's also drawn hefty talent around her.
reviews.author: Hanh Nguyen

reviews.text: There's no mystery about whether or not Enola Holmes is worth watching. It's a fantastic adventure, with a captivating lead, new supporting characters, and an always timely theme of female empowerment.
reviews.author: Stephanie Holland

reviews.text: [Millie Bobby] Brown gets to be witty, candid, and confident -- all the things a young heroine needs to inspire the next generation.
reviews.author: Clarisse Loughrey

reviews.text: Playing the kid sister to Henry Cavill's Sherlock Holmes, 'Stranger Things' star Millie Bobby Brown, just 16, shines her talent on its highest beams and creates a family entertainment that is totally irresistible.
reviews.author: Peter Travers

reviews.text: It was high time Nancy Drew got a companion in the badass female detective genre, and for that reason alone, Enola Holmes is worth watching.
reviews.author: Hannah Rachel Abraham

reviews.text: It doesn't just piggyback on Sherlock's beloved status, it promises a fresh origin story which is part coming-of-age comedy, and part literary revisionism. As a mystery, however, it leaves a lot to be desired.
reviews.author: Prahlad Srihari

reviews.text: It might not be the best or strongest iteration of Holmes, as much as a fun girl-friendlier spin on it, but there's no doubt it's perpetually entertaining.
reviews.author: Edward Douglas

reviews.text: The resolutions ofthe two mysteries are disappointing, relying on viewers to be so invested in Enola's success that the preposterousness of them don't really matter.
reviews.author: Daniel M. Kimmel

reviews.text: Enola Holmes would be a welcome diversion at any time. That it also confirms young Millie Bobby Brown as a major star is but frosting on the scone.
reviews.author: Robert W. Butler

reviews.text: [Brown is] the bright, sustaining spirit of a film that surrounds her with a fine cast and lovely trappings in a pleasantly twisty detective story that's elevated by the exuberance of Enola's detecting.
reviews.author: Joe Morgenstern

reviews.text: Look at the movie as a source of endless sequels, and you might sigh wearily. Reframe it as a star vehicle, however, and its charms are elementary.
reviews.author: David Fear

reviews.text: Based on the charms of "Enola Holmes," Netflix should be eager to keep this game afoot as long as its stars are willing to keep playing.
reviews.author: Brian Lowry

reviews.text: With its imaginative storytelling and visual inventiveness, "Enola Holmes" comes highly recommended for youngsters looking for a sassy heroine to rival the likes of Alex Ryder and other male screen heroes.
reviews.author: Adrian Hennigan

reviews.text: The good news is that further chapters would be welcome, if they all strike the same tone as this one.
reviews.author: Tom Santilli

reviews.text: [I] really enjoy this message of Enola Holmes being this girl who doesn't kind of fit into the regular stereotypes of what it mean to be a lady... [but] It kind of dragged a bit.
reviews.author: Kristen Maldonado

reviews.text: Filled with compelling adventures and enjoyable twists and performances, 'Enola Holmes' is the movie we need right now!
reviews.author: Preston Barta

reviews.text: Based on Nancy Springer's series of novels, director Harry Bradbeer's action-packed family film is a pip from beginning to end, and features one of the strongest young female heroines since Katniss Everdeen hit the bullseye.
reviews.author: Randy Myers

reviews.text: Brown is quite good in the role, playing into the qualities that keep her as eccentric as her brothers.
reviews.author: Aaron Neuwirth

reviews.text: The timing couldn't be more appropriate for a hero that overcomes the status quo, employs cunning; deductive reasoning, cryptology, erudition, science along with tenacity to solve commensurate puzzles than Enola Holmes.
reviews.author: Wendy Shreve

reviews.text: Enola Holmes puts a bright, lighthearted spin on detective work, and it gives its young star a chance to loosen up as well. Everybody is incredibly game for this material, letting it simply be the charming diversion it is.
reviews.author: Emily Wheeler

reviews.text: Enola's admirable traits, genuine goodness, and innocent retorts are what makes this heroine refreshing from other teen shows and films.
reviews.author: Tania Lamb

reviews.text: An immensely fun caper comedy.
reviews.author: Sarah Marrs

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a very well-made, well-paced and beautifully crafted family feature that has something for everyone to enjoy.
reviews.author: Ferdosa Abdi

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown brings the teenage sleuth to life with a spirited performance. It's fun, energetic, and hopefully the first of a series of films.
reviews.author: Joe Friar

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown is fantastic in this slick, charming and entertaining detective romp. Fun for the whole family. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Fico Cangiano

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown, who also produced, is delightful as the sister you didn't know Sherlock Holmes had. As Holmes, Henry Cavill has never been more likable.
reviews.author: James Verniere

reviews.text: "Enola Holmes" offers brisk and exuberant escape from the heaviness of modern times, with its leading actress lending her own appealing touches to the journey. When the game is afoot, she's more than capable, not just of keeping up, but winning the day.
reviews.author: Ann Hornaday

reviews.text: Even if the message of empowerment has a flat-pack quality, all involved have clearly been told: have fun! It goes a long way...
reviews.author: Danny Leigh

reviews.text: here's a charm on display here, as well as a sense of fun, that really makes all of the difference.
reviews.author: Joey Magidson

reviews.text: Executed with more energy than either of Guy Ritchie's recent blockbusters, and with Henry Cavill acting as a more suave Sherlock than Robert Downey Jr., director Harry Bradbeer's adventure is a perfectly fine piece of Holmes-ian content...
reviews.author: Barry Hertz

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is ultimately the kind of film that would have been better suited as a new Nickelodeon pilot.
reviews.author: Luke Gorham

reviews.text: In its brightest moments, Enola Holmes is charming, unexpected, and all-around inspiring. At its worst, it's still a pretty good detective story. You really can't go wrong with this one.
reviews.author: Charlie Ridgely

reviews.text: Playing a rebellious 16-year-old teenager is certainly a spot-on vehicle for Millie Bobby Brown, who exudes effortless charm with just enough spunk and sass to her title role.
reviews.author: Casey Chong

reviews.text: Pitched somewhere between Hermione Granger and Fleabag, Bobby Brown's Netflix rebel is the perfect blend of precocious wit and action finesse
reviews.author: Alex Flood

reviews.text: The world of this film is a pleasure to disappear into, and in Enola, Brown has found a role to which she seems perfectly - even uncannily - matched.
reviews.author: Glen Weldon

reviews.text: Despite its two-hour running time, Enola Holmes barrels along with stacks of energy, intellect and playful wit to spare.
reviews.author: Leigh Paatsch

reviews.text: Enola is a distinct and engaging character, and Enola Holmes definitely makes us look forward to another one or two or more of her adventures.
reviews.author: Mark Dujsik

reviews.text: Enola has verve and charm and you can't wait to see just how clever she can be.
reviews.author: Sherin Nicole

reviews.text: Charming and fun, perfect movie night for the whole family; Millie Bobby Brown was born for to play this role. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Jorge Rivera Rubio

reviews.text: Entertaining period mystery has feminist messages, violence.
reviews.author: Jennifer Green

reviews.text: Brown is delightful in the leading role, Claflin is magnificently aggravating as a secondary villain of sorts, and the devilishly handsome Cavill is effortlessly charming as the world's most famous detective.
reviews.author: Brent Hankins

reviews.text: Despite the mystery ahead of Enola, it's the life experiences that make the film feel worthwhile.
reviews.author: Daniel Hart

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a little overwrought, but Millie Bobby Brown's charming heroine and Henry Cavill's fun Sherlock pull off all the twists and turns.
reviews.author: Molly Freeman

reviews.text: There will always be a need for stories that carve out spaces in history for people other than white men, and a plucky girl detective who knows her way around a corset and a cryptograph is herself a much-needed role model.
reviews.author: Natalie Zutter

reviews.text: It all rattles along amiably enough.
reviews.author: Peter Bradshaw

reviews.text: On the surface, "Enola Holmes" is about a young woman in search of herself, but the film's value comes from a deeper investigation of power, familial bonds and the risks of changing a world determined to stay the same.
reviews.author: Lovia Gyarkye

reviews.text: If Enola Holmes isn't the start of a long-running franchise for Netflix, it will truly be a mystery as to why.
reviews.author: Travis Hopson

reviews.text: The game is pleasantly afoot yet again, with a new super-sleuth worthy of her forebears.
reviews.author: Brian Truitt

reviews.text: While millennials made do with Benedict Cumberbatch's considerably more conspiratorial Sherlock, Enola Holmes, like the teenagers towards whom it is targeted, is more hopeful for the future.
reviews.author: Rohan Naahar

reviews.text: [More] Robert Downey Jr. Sherlock Holmes than Benedict Cumberbatch Sherlock. ... [It] could have imbued [Enola] with more layers and allowed her to be more complex.
reviews.author: Akhil Arora

reviews.text: In a time where producers have to mine the literary vaults to repurpose existing properties to turn a quick buck, I enjoyed the liberties taken with "Enola Holmes" despite the overabundance of "Sherlock Holmes" stories that exist in the medium.
reviews.author: Nate Adams

reviews.text: What a terrific cast! Brown is perfect as the teenage, younger sister of the famed detective and Cavill does a nice job portraying Sherlock.
reviews.author: Allison Rose

reviews.text: It's so much fun, it's sure to be the beginning of a whole franchise.
reviews.author: Fred Topel

reviews.text: Enola Holmes zips along delightfully, despite the reasonably weighty runtime, mostly thanks to a heroine that you wouldn't mind meeting again.
reviews.author: Emma Simmonds

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a much-needed breath of fresh air at an unsteady time.
reviews.author: Jenn Adams

reviews.text: Politically and historically savvy adults and younger viewers seeking mystery, theatrics, and derring-do will certainly get the most out of Enola Holmes.
reviews.author: Andrew Parker

reviews.text: What joy Enola Holmes brings to these uncertain, often gloomy times! The feature plays like a classical adventure film from one's youth. Think more The Goonies than previous iterations of Sherlock Holmes.
reviews.author: Deirdre Molumby

reviews.text: The plucky, fourth-wall-breaking adventure/comedy is an ideal star vehicle for Millie Bobby Brown.
reviews.author: Edwin Arnaudin

reviews.text: The Victorian period is gorgeously recreated and evident in every prop, setting, and costume. Most importantly, Enola is a pickled pill just like the original Sherlock...expertly done by (Millie Bobby) Brown.
reviews.author: Jeff York

reviews.text: There's a certain kind of empty British movie, and "Enola Holmes" is it.
reviews.author: Mick LaSalle

reviews.text: Ultimately, the film's good intentions when coupled with Millie Bobby Brown's charm only make for a passable feature.
reviews.author: Sarah Gorr

reviews.text: Enola Holmes ideal "Saturday night family movie night" entertainment. Save for a few references to the (comparatively) more violent elements of the women's suffrage movement, it's light as a feather but that's entirely fine.
reviews.author: Scott Mendelson

reviews.text: [Enola's] honesty and passion for enacting change and becoming the creator of her future and destiny are what drives audiences to feel inspired and become enamored with her.
reviews.author: Ashley Menzel

reviews.text: Brown brings such delight with a joyous and fierce lead, who learns that even with good role models, she can forge her own path.
reviews.author: Shelagh Rowan-Legg

reviews.text: In Brown's Enola, we've found the right consulting detective we need for our times.
reviews.author: Kaila Hale-Stern

reviews.text: Manhandled politics aside, Enola Holmes offers plenty of whiz-bang in its mystery.
reviews.author: Kristy Puchko

reviews.text: It's diverting enough, and gives Brown a boost to cinematic stardom, but for die-hard Sherlock fans, this is fluff for a young audience, not a fascinating new take on the master detective bloodline.
reviews.author: Brian Orndorf

reviews.text: Despite a bloated, mostly uninteresting mystery, Enola Holmes is saved by a phenomenal performance from Millie Bobby Brown and an unforgettable take on Sherlock Holmes courtesy of Henry Cavill.
reviews.author: Josh Wilding

reviews.text: Enola Holmes doesn't feel like fan fiction so much as it feels like the work of someone who lifted universally famous characters for their own story, without so much as considering the characteristics that have made them so enduring for centuries.
reviews.author: Alistair Ryder

reviews.text: A woman writing or directing could have been more daring and nuanced, but it is still smashing to watch Holmes fight for Louis Partridge's male damsel in distress and create her own iconic persona.
reviews.author: Fatima Sheriff

reviews.text: At just over two hours, and with unnecessarily repetitive reminders of basic things, the film often loses its focus and veers into tedium.
reviews.author: Karen M. Peterson

reviews.text: An absolute delight! Brown makes an excellent female Sherlock Holmes (the famed detective's younger sister), while Cavill balances things brilliantly as the original.
reviews.author: Grace Randolph

reviews.text: The progressive and feminist message in Enola Holmes doesn't try to hide at all and, surprisingly, makes it all the more charming.
reviews.author: Catherine Springer

reviews.text: Even when the plot occasionally falters, Enola's continuous invitations to complicity renew the film's momentum.
reviews.author: Dan Rubins

reviews.text: Enola Holmes delivers a bold look at the past and imagines the world, not as it was, but how it should have been in the first place.
reviews.author: Victor Stiff

reviews.text: Brown's winning central performance is the main reason why this is a joy to watch and I really enjoyed feeling like I was in cahoots with Enola on her various quests. I hope that this is the start of a franchise, because it is an utter delight.
reviews.author: Fiona Underhill

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is spirited and whimsical, but tough as nails when a Jiu Jitsu takedown is needed. Millie Bobby Brown continues to impress as a lead actress.
reviews.author: Julian Roman

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a smart and fun film which keeps us on the edge of our seats as we watch Enola solve puzzles, crimes, become smitten, outsmart her brothers and the proverbial "bad guys" as she challenges the world to see women differently.
reviews.author: Pamela Powell

reviews.text: An irresistible adventure thanks to Milli Bowie Brown's charisma. [Full Review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Nestor Bentancor

reviews.text: Enola Holmes could be a one-off, but it would be a shame if that were the case.
reviews.author: Jordan Hoffman

reviews.text: Enola Holmes isn't a revolution or revelation that is going to forever alter the course of cinema, but it is enough of a charming and cheerful change to give Netflix a new franchise.
reviews.author: Brandon Katz

reviews.text: The juiced-up girl power of Enola Holmes makes for a right-on, righteously fun romp with a revved-up, fem-forward message that rings loud and true even today.
reviews.author: Neil Pond

reviews.text: "Enola Holmes" is a compelling mystery and a sprightly adventure with a feminist streak that's a perfect showcase for the winsome talents of "Stranger Things" star Millie Bobby Brown.
reviews.author: Rodrigo Perez

reviews.text: A tale of adventure, mystery, and finding oneself. While you will probably figure it all out well before Enola does, this movie is still worth a watch.
reviews.author: Tessa Smith

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a fun ride with a heroine we all need right now. She's bold, she's funny and she's more than a little sarcastic.
reviews.author: Rachel Wagner

reviews.text: A boisterous and clever delight, with an energetic and effervescent performance from Millie Bobby Brown.
reviews.author: Sarah Cartland

reviews.text: Most of it is rousing, crowd-pleasing entertainment, the kind of thing that would have worked well on a big screen but is still ideal for a family movie night at home.
reviews.author: Josh Bell

reviews.text: Phew. The prevailing emotion on watching Millie Bobby Brown play Sherlock Holmes's teenage sister in this jaunty adaptation of Nancy Springer's novels is relief.
reviews.author: Ed Potton

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is adventurous, fun, comedic, and just the right heart-warming young adult adventure for the times.
reviews.author: Kate Sánchez

reviews.text: An elongated run time and a whimper of a finale stands to tarnish what should be the makings of a fun franchise. But with its spry spirit, it's a noteworthy beginning.
reviews.author: Courtney Howard

reviews.text: 'Enola Holmes' is a total charmer that will have you eager to see further adventures of this young detective.
reviews.author: Matt Goldberg

reviews.text: With the wit and charm of Millie Bobby Brown at the forefront, Enola Holmes makes for a fresh start of a new detective franchise.
reviews.author: Danielle Solzman

reviews.text: ... books serve as the inspiration for Enola Holmes, adapted by Jack Thorne (The Secret Garden) and directed by Harry Bradbeer (Fleabag), a vigorous young adult period adventure tale that skewers tradition in favor of modernity.
reviews.author: Douglas Davidson

reviews.text: "Enola Holmes" reveals itself to be genuinely appealing for a wide audience.
reviews.author: Kate Erbland

reviews.text: Brown's acting style recalls the effusive spontaneity Keira Knightley brought to "Sense and Sensibility," shattering the straitlaced propriety of so many Jane Austen adaptations before it.
reviews.author: Peter Debruge

reviews.text: It successfully imagines a place for its heroine in Holmes' world, then convinces young viewers that Enola needn't be constrained by that world's borders.
reviews.author: John DeFore

reviews.text: An infuriating near-miss of a movie where the biggest mystery is why it's so long and meandering.
reviews.author: Tom Beasley

reviews.text: Jack Thorne's sometimes thin screenplay aims for a sunny-side-up appeal, but too often these cheery morals hit you over the head like a ton of bricks.
reviews.author: Ella Kemp

reviews.text: Enola Holmes is a breezy family adventure that confirms further stardom for Millie Bobby Brown. However, it is ultimately lacking in memorability and does not utilise its cast effectively.
reviews.author: Lewis Knight

reviews.text: Millie Bobby Brown is terrific as Enola Holmes, charismatic & endearing in a role that could have been irritating. It's a shame the mystery itself just isn't that interesting.
reviews.author: Ian Sandwell

synopsis: While searching for her missing mother, intrepid teen Enola Holmes uses her sleuthing skills to outsmart big brother Sherlock and help a runaway lord.
